Plate stays snug chest and arms hold edges unchanged, NO arms extended or plate floating. Feet/knees/pelvis fixed, same model/limb lengths/scale. Primary ABS ONE smooth diffuse BLURRED red tint on intact opaque abdominal BLACK SHIRT BELOW chest plate, no sixpack/rays/fibers/anatomy through fabric. Fine detailed EXPOSED grayscale muscle contours arms/calves, realistic proportions, equal male/female quality. Reference original project artwork ONLY rendering STYLE, never its bench push-up pose/chest red. Full opaque BLACK athletic shirt and MID-THIGH shorts continuously wrap FRONT SIDES BACK SEAT CROTCH with seams and BROAD cloth folds, no cutaway/transparency/anatomy through clothing. Black shoes. White background soft grounded shadows. Whole mat/plate/body/limbs fully contained EACH cell with generous head/shoe margins, no cross-cell overlap. No embedded captions/text/labels/arrows.
